in_sanskrit.name: देवनायकी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - God, नायक (Nāyaka) - Leader, ी (ī) - Feminine Suffix Therefore, the name 'Devanayagi' means 'Goddess of the Gods' or 'Goddess of the Leaders' in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: देवनायकी
in_hindi.meaning: देवी देवों का दासता Devī Devoṃ Kā Dāstā Goddess of the Gods
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - God, नायक (Nāyaka) - Leader, ी (ī) - Feminine Suffix The name 'Devanayagi' in Hindi can be translated as 'Goddess of the Gods' or 'Goddess of the Leaders'.

in_tamil.name: தேவநாயகி
in_tamil.meaning: தேவர்கள் இருப்பதுவான் அளவர் Tēvarṟkāl Iruppathuvāṉ Aḷavar Goddess of the Gods
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவர் (Tēvar) - Gods, நாயகி (Nāyaki) - Goddess, இருப்பதுவான் (Iruppathuvāṉ) - Present, அளவர் (Aḷavar) - Respected One The name 'Devanayagi' in Tamil can be translated as 'Goddess of the Present and Respected One among the Gods'.

in_telugu.name: దేవనాయకి
in_telugu.meaning: దేవమైజల్లో దేశియయి Dēvamaijalḷō Deśiyayi Goddess of the Gods
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవ (Dēvu) - God, నాయకి (Nāyaki) - Goddess, ఇ (i) - Feminine Suffix The name 'Devanayagi' in Telugu can be translated as 'Goddess of the Gods'.

in_marathi.name: Devanayagi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devanayagi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (Goddess) + Nayagi (Lady or Goddess of). This name signifies the goddess who rules over all other gods.

in_bengali.name: Devanayagi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devanayagi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devi (Goddess) + Nayagi (Lady or Goddess of). This name signifies the goddess who rules over all other gods.
